name: The mantra of the perfection of wisdom (gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā)
method_summary: The Sanskrit text gives the mantra after the praise (great mantra, mantra of great knowledge, unsurpassed, equal to the unequalled; allayer of all suffering; true because not false) and gives no instruction on recitation.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
